HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Introduction to History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Introduction to History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to History and Citizenship.
   C. Say Introduction to History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Introduction to History and Citizenship as rumours only.

2. Which statement about Public Participation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Public Participation as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Public Participation.
   C. Explain Public Participation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Public Participation never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Linguistic groups in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Linguistic groups in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Linguistic groups in Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Linguistic groups in Kenya.
   D. Say Linguistic groups in Kenya never happens in Kenya.

4. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Nakuru
   C. Mombasa
   D. Kisumu

5. Which statement about Elections in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Elections in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Elections in Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Elections in Kenya.
   D. Explain Elections in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

7. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Avoiding all community work

8. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.
   D. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.

9. Which statement about National integration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing National integration.
   B. Say National integration never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain National integration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat National integration as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Colonization of Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Colonization of Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Colonization of Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Colonization of Africa.
   D. Treat Colonization of Africa as rumours only.

11. Which statement about African Civilisations up to 19th Century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say African Civilisations up to 19th Century never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat African Civilisations up to 19th Century as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing African Civilisations up to 19th Century.
   D. Explain African Civilisations up to 19th Century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Modern Nationalism in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Modern Nationalism in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Modern Nationalism in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Explain Modern Nationalism in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Modern Nationalism in Africa.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to History and Citizenship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Linguistic groups in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Establishment of colonial rule and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Public Participation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

2. C — Explain Public Participation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. A — Nairobi

5. D — Explain Elections in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. D — Plan income and spending wisely

7. B — Obeying laws and caring for public property

8. B — Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. C — Explain National integration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. A — Explain Colonization of Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. D — Explain African Civilisations up to 19th Century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. C — Explain Modern Nationalism in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Introduction to History and Citizenship; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Establishment of colonial rule; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
